contract_plain_english: For independent symmetric Bernoulli random variables X₁,…,X_N, deterministic real coefficients a₁,…,a_N, and the proof’s fixed parameter λ > 0, the expected exponential of the weighted sum equals the product of the expected exponentials of its individual weighted terms: E[exp(λ ∑ a_iX_i)] = ∏ E[exp(λa_iX_i).] The source says this factorization follows immediately from independence [PDF page 4; printed page 15, sentence immediately preceding Equation (2.6) and Equation (2.6)].
